name: Eforu Entertainment Limited
about: Eforu Entertainment Limited engages in organizing and managing various events for corporates, companies, and individuals in India and internationally. It organizes events, such as luxury events, government/private events, road shows, expos, seminars, fashion shows, concerts, parties, conferences, social events, game shows, fun events, and ticket sales/bookings, as well as acquire, sell, hire, import/export, and installs equipment. The company is also involved in artist & celebrity management, brand promotion, and corporate events; developing, promoting, and managing artists, celebrities, product brands, corporate/business themes, product launches, pr, media relations, concept design, and brand building through events; organize and manage international/local music events. In addition, it offers support services, artist and celebrity management, brand promotion, and corporate events services, as well as engages in the real estate business. The company was formerly known as Tavernier Resources Limited. Eforu Entertainment Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
